name: scraper
description: - **Site**: https://books.toscrape.com - **Why**: Books to Scrape is explicitly built by toscrape.com as a sandbox   for practicing web scraping. - **Scope**: the first 3 pages only. - **Data collected**: book titles, prices, and star ratings from those pages. - **robots.txt result**:GET https://books.toscrape.com/robots.txt returned 404 - **Why this is appropriate**: the site is a purpose-built practice sandbox,   the scope is small and read-only, and no robots.txt rules are being   overridden since none exist.
